items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: one of the first jobs I had was with Georgie Brunus, Elmer Schauble, and Ralph Snyder

ctx.x: Remember who else was in your earliest bands up there?
Well, one of the first jobs I had was with Georgie Brunus, Elmer Schauble, and Ralph Snyder, I think the drummer. The drummer. The rest I can't...
Was that after they'd been at the Friars Inn, they'd left there?
